title: Diffs, pictures, and timing to the word

intro.say: Three things the engine can show besides plain code.

chapters.title: A change, shown as a change
chapters.say: What did this commit actually do?

beats.say: Here is one function before and after a change. The green lines are new.
It now builds a key, looks in the cache, and returns early on a hit.
Only on a miss does it reach the database, and then it saves the result for five minutes.

chapters.title: Any page, any PDF
chapters.say: Not everything worth explaining is code.

scenes.heading: A web page, captured as it is

beats.say: This is a real web page, captured by the browser as it looks right now.
The camera can move to any part of it, found by its text.
A page of a PDF works the same way.
The phrase is located in the document itself, so the box always lands on words that are really there.
For an ordinary image, a region is given as coordinates.

chapters.title: Timed to the word
chapters.say: A highlight used to wait for the next sentence. Not anymore.

beats.say: Watch the highlight land on the key, then the lookup, then the early return, each as it is named.
The voice model reports when every word is spoken, and the picture follows.
